description: This file defines a React component named 'Cart' that manages the shopping cart UI in an e-commerce application. It connects to Redux for state management, rendering cart items, summary, and checkout options, and handles user interactions such as toggling the cart and removing items.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: React component representing the shopping cart UI, including item list, summary, and checkout functionalities.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the cart UI, including header, list of items, and checkout section based on current props.
